svg.title: 50-record FTAI Power audit: conditional 0 to 9.2 GW coverage range
svg.desc: 24 measurable records have 18.56 GW electrical scope. Subtract 9.379 GW credited supply and operating capacity to get 9.181 GW conditional ceiling. 26 records are excluded. Actual uncontracted demand and shortage duration remain unverified.

g.text: FTAI POWER · CUSTOMER DEMAND AUDIT
Earlier electricity has a customer.
50 US records reviewed · 2027–28 screen · Evidence cutoff October 6, 2026
Conditional contract-coverage range
24 measurable records
26 held out · Full 50-record upper bound unavailable
18.56 GW of announced electrical scope in the measurable subset
9.38 GW credited
Quantified arrangements + operating minimums
9.18 GW ceiling
Numerical supply match still unresolved
A screening ceiling, not a verified shortage or an open order book.
Full campus scope where phases are undisclosed. Assumed 1.2 PUE where only IT load is available.
The zero floor reflects missing contract evidence. It does not establish zero customer need.
366 MW

FTAI's opening: deliver when customer schedules run ahead of available electricity.
Source: 50-record public-source audit; power_gap_bridge.csv and power_gap_audit.csv.
No FTAI capture or competition haircut. Grid-timing gaps remain separate and unquantified.
